title: Hypothetical nuclear-principle electromagnetic power source whose load can't be controlled

tellings.quote: >> hypothetically, if you have an electromagnetic power source that probably operates off of nuclear principles and it gives off energy and you can't control the load,

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2026, sets out what he frames as a hypothetical: a power source that works by electromagnetism, probably runs on nuclear principles, and gives off energy whose load cannot be controlled. He presents it as something he has first-hand knowledge of, and mentions people named Towns and Brown, while keeping the details vague. If true, it would point to an energy technology too strong or too strange to be handled safely.
